description: This file defines the AuthManager class, which manages authentication state, token persistence, login, lock/unlock, refresh, and logout functionalities within an Android application. It handles session states, token storage, and provides an API for UI components to interact with authentication processes.

classes.name: AuthManager
classes.description: Core class managing authentication sessions, token storage, and state transitions, providing an API for login, logout, lock, unlock, refresh, and state observation.

methods.name: authStateFlow
methods.description: Returns a flow of authentication state updates for observers.

methods.name: currentState
methods.description: Returns the current authentication state snapshot.

methods.name: initializeFromStorage
methods.description: Loads persisted session tokens on app startup, setting state to Locked if tokens are found, or LoggedOut if not.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs login by exchanging credentials for tokens via a provided suspend function, then stores tokens and updates state to Unlocked.

methods.name: lock
methods.description: Locks the current session, keeping tokens persisted but setting session state to Locked.

methods.name: unlock
methods.description: Unlocks the current session after successful biometric or credential verification.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Clears tokens from storage and sets state to LoggedOut.

methods.name: getAccessTokenIfUnlocked
methods.description: Returns the access token if the session is unlocked; otherwise, fails.

methods.name: ensureFreshAccessToken
methods.description: Checks if the access token is expired, refreshes it if necessary, or locks the session if refresh fails.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to create an AuthManager with default dependencies for production.

methods.name: createForTesting
methods.description: Factory method to create an AuthManager with custom dependencies for testing.
